name: Boundless API
overview: Boundless advertises a $5 signup credit without a card. Its FAQ says the welcome tier is limited to Starter models and 10 requests/minute; trial eligibility and expiry should be confirmed in the dashboard. It also offers optional automatic recharge. No signup, inference, billing or claimed model identity was independently tested.
notes: Base URL https://api.boundlessapi.com/v1. This example is a catalogue claim, not confirmation that it is included on Starter.
